description: Mira at the culture festival: all of KG_S6.BIN, KG_S6S.BIN, KG_S6W.BIN (902 strings; base 0x801E8000). Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her acceptance (S6S) and the tour of the Literature exhibit (S6W). Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
